title: Wooden Windway Whistle with Cord
description: One complete static wooden whistle: a small closed-walled wooden body with true narrow end windway, connected internal chamber, open top wind window, full sloping labium insert keyed into the roof, and a continuous cord loop through a real transverse rear bore. Three editable closed solids and two matte opaque PBR materials. Not the earlier slit percussion woodblock with a mallet: the mouth windway, bevel edge, short open window and rear lanyard are separately modelled complete features. Metres, Z up, horizontally centred and broad flat wooden sole at Z0. Small fixed interface insertions retain attachments. Static visual prop only; no measured pitch, airflow, acoustic effectiveness, manufacturing, cord motion or safety performance claimed.
